motions.motion: Board Member Burnham moved to affirm the Planning Commission approval of ihe 7-Eleven conditional use permit and instructed legal counsel to draft an opinion. Board Member Curtis seconded the motion. Those voting aye: Donna Burnham, Melissa Clark, Colby Curtis, Jared Gray, and Carolyn Love. The motion passed with a unanimous vote.
